data.raw_text:
She didn’t just steal it. She planned to poop it out. 🤮

Manila airport. A security officer caught on camera stuffing $300 in cash down her throat like it was a chocolate bar.
Why?
Because she got busted stealing from a passenger’s wallet and thought she could hide the evidence in her stomach.
You read that right.
She swallowed the cash…
with help from coworkers who handed her water to wash it down.
No escape plan.
No exit strategy.
Just raw desperation and a hope it’d reappear in a toilet bowl two days later.
They didn’t just fire her.
They banned pockets in the entire airport.
